summary.blocking_reason: No remaining manifest-level card gaps after m31. All non-token Deck A cards are parity_checked under the current semantic trace, normalized LegalActions, and C++ unit-test audit suite. This is still an executable audit verdict rather than a formal proof over every possible game state.
summary.semantic_parity: 27 / 27 semantic cases pass under documented compare ignores

status_legend.parity_checked: At least one Python/C++ semantic trace covers the current C++ behavior and passes under the documented compare key set.
status_legend.implemented_unchecked: C++ has an implementation, but there is not yet a dedicated passing Python/C++ trace for the full card behavior.
status_legend.partial: C++ implements a useful subset but is known to omit one or more Python behaviors.
status_legend.data_only: C++ catalog has card data but no functional effect implementation yet.
status_legend.token_data: Token/data card with no standalone effect requirement.

cards.name: 腥膻之味
cards.cpp_notes: m30: dedicated semantic trace deck_a_semantic_blood_scent_leader covers leader bleeding target and charge usage; final Ekimmara random-row spawn remains covered by C++ unit tests. Legal surface still has documented post-leader pass/end-turn representation gap.

cards.name: 注魔盔甲
cards.cpp_notes: Boost+armor on hand unit exists; order now waits for explicit end_turn before consuming the stratagem, matching Python semantic trace.

cards.name: 雷吉斯：重生
cards.cpp_notes: Deploy drain and hand/deck turn-end base-power growth are implemented and covered by the former bruxa pending Regis semantic case.

cards.name: 暗影长者
cards.cpp_notes: m30: dedicated semantic trace deck_a_semantic_elder covers deploy bleeding target and turn transition parity for the current implementation; random turn-end branch is additionally covered by C++ unit tests.

cards.name: 巨型蜈蚣
cards.cpp_notes: m30: dedicated semantic trace deck_a_semantic_centipede covers deploy armor gain path; armor_broken self-destroy remains covered by C++ unit tests.

cards.name: 狄拉夫·艾瑞廷
cards.cpp_notes: Deploy now requests an enemy-row pending choice and adds Blood Moon to the selected row; order damages a bleeding enemy; deathblow spawns Ekimmara in the same row; Blood Moon turn-start tick is implemented. Covered by dedicated row-choice semantic trace plus C++ unit tests.

cards.name: 裂流之主
cards.cpp_notes: m30: dedicated semantic trace deck_a_semantic_riptide_melee covers melee deploy clash path and legal deploy-row parity after m29; hand armor branch remains covered by C++ unit tests.

cards.name: 卡塔卡恩
cards.cpp_notes: m31: dedicated semantic trace deck_a_semantic_katakan_order covers same-row order spawn flow after a pass back to the Katakan controller. C++ unit tests also cover bleeding-added cooldown reduction.

cards.name: 薇瑞娜
cards.cpp_notes: m30: dedicated semantic trace deck_a_semantic_verena covers deploy bleeding and boost-block listener installation for current behavior; boost-block enforcement remains covered by C++ unit tests.

cards.name: 纳吉尔法
cards.cpp_notes: M26/M27: randomly reveals/stores two gold deck candidates, supports named candidate selection in semantic traces, puts the unchosen card on deck top, finishes Naglfar, and if the chosen card is a unit asks for an explicit own-row placement before playing it. Covered by deck_a_semantic_naglfar_named_deck_choice.

cards.name: 伊勒瑞斯
cards.cpp_notes: m30: dedicated semantic trace deck_a_semantic_imlerith_melee_discard covers melee deploy draw/discard/boost flow. C++ pending discard candidates were fixed to expose all hand cards, matching Python legal surface.

cards.name: 盖尔
cards.cpp_notes: M27: candidate filtering is implemented; selected special plays directly, selected unit asks for explicit own-row placement before being played. Covered by deck_a_semantic_geels_named_deck_choice with seed=2.

cards.name: 欧兹瑞尔
cards.cpp_notes: m31: dedicated semantic traces cover both deploy branches: ranged consumes own cemetery unit and melee consumes enemy cemetery unit. Cemetery consume banishes the consumed unit and boosts Ozzrel by that unit current power.

cards.name: 夜之女王
cards.cpp_notes: m30: dedicated semantic trace deck_a_semantic_queen_melee covers melee deploy bleeding branch. Ranged purify branch still has C++ unit coverage but not a dedicated semantic trace.

cards.name: 蝠翼魔
cards.cpp_notes: Bleeding-added boost/countdown behavior now matches Python in the dedicated trace; countdown is effect-local and not a generic turn counter.

cards.name: 夜行吸血鬼
cards.cpp_notes: m30: dedicated semantic trace deck_a_semantic_garkain_order covers order bleeding path; melee-only order restriction and cooldown paths remain covered by C++ and legal-surface audits. Legal surface still has documented post-order pass/end-turn representation gap.

cards.name: 吸血鬼女
cards.cpp_notes: Deploy pending target and bleeding are covered by the Regis and Fleder semantic cases; order still needs a dedicated case.

cards.name: 猩红盛宴
cards.cpp_notes: Special implementation exists and parity case covers explicit pending target: purify enemy unit, damage 3, and apply bleeding 3 when the controller has a friendly Vampire.

cards.name: 艾恩·艾尔征服者
cards.cpp_notes: m31: dedicated semantic trace deck_a_semantic_conqueror_veil covers Veil status parity against Blood Scent. C++ unit tests also verify Veil blocks status application until purify removes it.

cards.name: 渴血鸟怪
cards.cpp_notes: m31: dedicated semantic trace deck_a_semantic_bloodscented_predator covers deploy pending target and bleeding application. C++ unit tests cover bonded branch using target base power.

cards.name: 狂猎骑士
cards.cpp_notes: m31: dedicated semantic trace deck_a_semantic_wild_hunt_rider covers dominance summon from deck to same row. C++ unit tests also verify each matching deck copy is summoned exactly once and the duplicate-move bug is fixed.

cards.name: 蝙魔
cards.cpp_notes: Token data exists and can be spawned.
